## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install automated_testing in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure automated_testing package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to automated_testing
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/jit3pam/automated-testing):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/jit3pam/automated-testing.git
```

or from
[conda](https://anaconda.org/jit3pam/automated-testing)\[**TODO**\]

``` sh
$ conda install -c jit3pam automated_testing
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/automated-testing/)\[**TODO**\]

``` sh
$ pip install automated_testing
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/jit3pam/automated-testing)’s
[pages](https://jit3pam.github.io/automated-testing/). Additionally you
can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/jit3pam/automated-testing) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/automated-testing/) respectively.
